instruction: Implement EVERY card in this pack. Clone from clone_path; match effect_text. Use duel_helpers.h. Spells: only edit the listed .c file. Activated/permanent may need monster_effects.h / dispatcher — serialize those. Do not leave TODO bodies. One make at the end of the whole batch.

cards.effect_text: You can Tribute 1 other face-up "Gravekeeper's" monster to target 1 card your opponent controls; destroy that target. You can Tribute 1 other face-up Gravekeeper's monster to target 1 card your opponent controls; destroy that target.

Shuffle Def monster; mill 3 at End. If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, before damage calculation: Shuffle that monster into the Deck. Once per turn, during your End Phase: Send the top 3 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard.

Dark Magician + 1 Dragon monster This card's name becomes Dark Magician while on the field or in the GY. Your opponent cannot target Spells/Traps you control with card effects, also they cannot be destroyed by your opponent's card effects.

If this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent by a direct attack: Discard 1 random card from your opponent's hand If this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent by a direct attack: Discard 1 random card from your opponent's hand.
